Reproduced 2x on mobile viewport (390x844): clicking 'Search your Solution Box…' input, then pressing 'e','k','a','n','g','a' one key at a time. Only the first 'e' registered; document.activeElement became BODY after the first keystroke (focused=False for keys 2..6). The change to ListHeaderComponent={renderHeader()} in prr.tsx did not resolve the issue — the input still blurs on every keystroke. Could not fully exercise UI because the Action Plan section sits on a later step of MyDezider (the only available P&C item opened to Step 6/10 — Define Options). action_items: CRITICAL: Re-fix Solution Box search focus retention. Current approach (calling renderHeader() inline) still causes remount of the header subtree on every keystroke because SolutionBoxScreen re-renders on each setSearch, and renderHeader() returns a brand-new element tree containing ListFilterBar/TextInput.

Recommended fix options (any one): (a) Hoist the search bar OUT of FlatList's ListHeaderComponent and render it as a sibling above the FlatList — this is what the Shared tab effectively achieves and that tab works. (b) Wrap ListFilterBar in React.memo AND pass stable handlers via useCallback so the memo'd subtree is preserved across keystrokes. (c) Move the search TextInput to its own component file with React.memo and pass value+onChange via stable refs.
Add testID='solution-box-search' to the search TextInput inside ListFilterBar (or expose a prop searchTestID) so this regression can be locked down by an automated test.

After re-fix, verify the same behaviour also holds with FlatList data prop changing from N → 0 (e.g. type a string that filters everything out) since that branch swaps ListEmptyComponent and was likely the trigger here.

ActionItemEditor.tsx: when editing, formatDMY(it.by_when) handles both 'YYYY-MM-DD' and ISO timestamps correctly via _parse(). Verified.

rca_of_issue: Focus loss in Solution Box happens because the header (which contains the search TextInput inside ListFilterBar) is recreated on every keystroke. The fix ListHeaderComponent={renderHeader()} only changes whether RN treats the prop as element-vs-component; it does NOT prevent a re-render of the parent SolutionBoxScreen on each setSearch which still produces a NEW JSX tree for the header. When FlatList sees displayItems shrink (e.g. matches drop to 0 between 'e' and 'ek') it also swaps to ListEmptyComponent, further disturbing the tree. Net effect: TextInput unmounts/remounts, blur fires, focus → BODY. Fix: move the search input out of ListHeaderComponent (sibling above FlatList) or memoise the header subtree so its React identity is stable across data changes.
